name: MOSFET load module
description: On/off control of an externally powered load module with a 3.3 V compatible, active-HIGH input. No speed control.

electrical.notes: Use an externally powered driver module with a 3.3 V compatible input drawing at most 1 mA, common GND, and LOW = off. Never connect a bare coil, motor, buzzer or load directly to GPIO. Use appropriate inductive protection. Active-LOW modules are not supported.
